Description
Scheldt Procurement Interim places experienced procurement professionals with manufacturers in the Benelux and Germany. For our client, a frozen food producer with plants in Cologne, Ghent and Eindhoven (EUR 1.3 billion revenue), we are looking for an interim Category Manager for indirect spend.

The client's procurement team was reorganised after the merger of the German and the Belgian business. The indirect categories have so far been managed by the plants and are now being bundled centrally. The permanent category manager will join in May 2027.

Your responsibilities
• Take over the indirect categories facility management, MRO, logistics services and temporary labour (addressable spend of around EUR 85 million)
• Run a spend analysis across three ERP systems and build a savings pipeline together with the plant controllers
• Develop category strategies and a tender calendar for 2027
• Lead the tenders for facility services and MRO, including negotiations and contract award
• Harmonise framework agreements and bring the categories into the new source-to-pay process in Coupa
• Report savings and progress monthly to the Chief Procurement Officer

Your profile
• 8+ years in strategic procurement with a strong track record in indirect categories
• Experience with procurement integration after a merger is a plus
• Proven negotiation skills and a hands-on attitude
• Good command of Coupa or SAP Ariba and advanced Excel and Power BI skills
• Fluent English; Dutch or German is an advantage

Conditions
• Fully remote is possible; we expect you on site in Cologne or Ghent about two days per month
• Start 1 November 2026, 6 months, extension possible
• Day rate EUR 900 to 1,000, travel expenses reimbursed
• Freelance contract with Scheldt Procurement Interim B.V.; you should be based in the Netherlands, Belgium or Germany
